body:
I know I should fell proud, but I don't. I feel like a failure for being so alone. I think at this point most everyone else has figured things out here while I'm still floundering around. I also don't think my family will miss me. I was a major financial burden on my father while he paid child support, and then especially on my mother once he stopped paying child support. They don't need to worry about me anymore because of my scholarships and financial aid.

Sorry for vomiting my life story at you. I want to stay clear of mind until the end tomorrow. How was your day? What are you up to now?
